title: Internal: handling procedure for reversing a top-up after reinstatement
content:
## Applicable situation
This entry covers reversing a Pro Shop Store Credit top-up as a fraud-prevention safeguard once a suspended account is reinstated back to active status. It governs the amount actually refunded off the account for such a reversal, so that the account resumes from a clean, reverified balance once it is active again.

A refund of a top-up may be recorded only while the account is active or in the same moment as its confirmed cancellation to closed. Where the account is not in one of those two states, no refund of this kind is recorded. An account is not reinstated to active status by this refund itself — reinstatement is its own separate matter, and this refund is recorded only once the account already stands active (or is being closed in that same moment).

## How it is invoked
Reversing a top-up under this entry is carried out through an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call): refund_topup_amount_847aef7e. The representative prices the refund amount before making this call.

## Parameters
- credit_account_id: the store-credit account's own reference number, reachable by looking up the member's store-credit account before the call.
- refund_amount: the dollar amount to remove from the account's spendable balance for this refund, in USD, with exactly two decimal places, already rounded to the cent, and always zero or positive.

## Return
A successful call returns a confirmation naming the new transaction's own reference number and the exact dollar amount refunded; that confirmation is how the representative knows the refund was recorded and the balance decreased by that amount.
